data.hypothesis: The bdce72cb10924576 program is the better measured, correct input, so retaining it unchanged is the strongest candidate. Importing 1d122d9ba23047ef's block-16 setting would not fit the full-warp ownership mapping directly, and its Newton-refined rsqrt variant was measured only in a slower program.
data.notes: Kept bdce72cb10924576 intact: shared source tiles, one target per warp, lane-strided accumulation, warp reduction, and rsqrtf inverse-distance cubing. Excluded 1d122d9ba23047ef: it is valid and correct but its reported mean (0.0008172374 s) is slower than bdce's (0.0000944663 s); its block-16 mapping is incompatible with the full-warp shuffle as-is. No new composition or independent confirmation is claimed; the controller should confirm final G.
transformations: Kept bdce72cb10924576's complete source and launch configuration unchanged: 256 threads, eight targets per CTA, 2048-source shared-memory tiles, lane-strided warp accumulation and shuffle reduction, and rsqrtf inverse-distance cubing.
Did not retain 1d122d9ba23047ef's block-16 configuration or Newton refinement; the former does not match the warp mapping as supplied, and the latter was not supported by a faster measured program.
